test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Nov 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.**

I've discussed all the options with you. There are __no more__ options available for you.
solution:
The correct answer is that **no substitution is required. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The usage of no more __in the above sentence is correct.

 __
 
• **No more **is a phrase that means** nothing further.**
 
• **No more **is used to talk about the absence of something that was once there.
 
 
• **Example**: I*** ****will ask**** no more ****questions.**​​***
 
 
 
• ***​ *Any more** is used with **negation**; but in the above-given sentence, if we substitute** any more** in place of **no more **without the usage of negation, this leads to **grammatical error.__**
 
• Hence we can say that there is **no need **for substitution of the __**underlined segment.**__
 
 
 
• __**Therefore, **the correct answer is **option 4.**__

**​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

 
• We use **no more** and not anymore as determiners.

 
 
• **No more** is more formal than not anymore.

 
 
• ** Example**: *There **isn't any more** cake. They've eaten it all.​*
